cases.behavior: Generate an associated capability's complete target Spec from its Delta before Shape confirmation without overwriting independent edits.
cases.reproduction: The Delta-only Shape fixture retained the old complete target before implementation; the identical new test failed on missing added behavior.
cases.expected: Generate the complete target, update a previously generated target when its receipt matches, and keep complete Specs in approval and acceptance.
cases.forbidden: Replacing independently edited targets, changing confirmed targets during revalidation, or treating conflicting baseline requirements as compatible.
cases.rootCause: Shape validated the agent-maintained target against Delta but did not materialize it through the public preparation path.

tests.namePattern: materializes a Delta target before Shape and refuses independent target edits|does not enter Build when Shape documents change after approval
requiredNames: materializes a Delta target before Shape and refuses independent target edits
does not enter Build when Shape documents change after approval

cases.behavior: 正式 Spec 改变导致 Builder 提交被拒绝后，以原 claim 的失败收据结束原 Action，再在同一 change 内重新确认，保留拒绝记录。
cases.reproduction: 批准 Shape 并 claim Builder 后修改正式 Spec，再从公开 Runtime 提交原候选；原错误响应只有 inspect 入口，没有原失败收据和变化文件。
cases.expected: 拒绝仍记录审计收据，响应指出变化的 Spec 并提供绑定原 Action/claim 的失败请求；原命令可执行且重复提交不重复推进，随后原 change 可进入 Shape 重新确认。
cases.forbidden: 自动批准改动、清除原 Run 或拒绝记录、要求重建 change，或向错误 claim 提供原失败收据。
cases.rootCause: 状态转换已支持失败 Builder 的需求修订，但拒绝响应没有将这条恢复链与原 Action、变化文件和现有失败请求模板关联。

tests.namePattern: recovers a rejected Builder after formal Spec drift|does not disclose a Builder failure receipt
requiredNames: Native dispatch CLI presentation recovers a rejected Builder after formal Spec drift through the original failure receipt and reconfirms the same change
Native dispatch CLI presentation does not disclose a Builder failure receipt to a rejected outcome with another claim

cases.behavior: Archive completes with structured accepted evidence when derived report rendering fails.
cases.reproduction: Make missing and edited report rendering fail during public Archive, then recover the completed receipt. Separately edit the approved implementation.
cases.expected: Preserve edited report bytes and stable receipts; reject changed candidates before Spec publication.
cases.forbidden: Lose authored report text, rerun accepted checks solely for report failure, or publish a changed candidate.
cases.rootCause: Generated reading views previously blocked completion and occupied separate revalidation Actions.

tests.namePattern: ^(?:completes v3 Archive with a missing report when view rendering fails and preserves its receipt|completes v3 Archive with a edited report when view rendering fails and preserves its receipt|rejects candidate drift before v3 Archive publication after merging the revalidation Action)$
requiredNames: completes v3 Archive with a missing report when view rendering fails and preserves its receipt
completes v3 Archive with a edited report when view rendering fails and preserves its receipt
rejects candidate drift before v3 Archive publication after merging the revalidation Action
